name: cobuilder-plugin
description: Plugins that keep engineers in charge of their coding agents: design, build, review, and maintain a system.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Design a change, audit the repo, track drift, explore options, and diagnose failures. Five self-only commands for a local git repo.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Interview an author and open a PR with intent, then narrate it after the merge. Output is a portable .cobuilder-architect/ bundle.

plugins.name: artifact
plugins.description: Open a local viewer for designs, decisions, builds, and PRs. Publish one PR as a Claude Artifact. Draw a design as a tldraw canvas.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: Build a design one tested slice at a time, with four approval gates, blind rubrics, and independent validation.

plugins.name: cobuilder-full-lifecycle
plugins.description: Install all of CoBuilder: architecture, implementation, review, and maintenance, with the engineer in charge at each stage.
